Both signature families are verified in the newest archived stage while independent domain lineages remain credited; classification stays conservatively at LSM-UNKNOWN with zero motive or access inference.

The checked Chalmers record (25 frozen texts from 1990 to 2025, and one source-gated 2012 reply) states global availability; constructed perception; organizational invariance; extended coupling; welfare and governance; identity, continuity and memory; virtual realism; and emulation and uploading before Micah Blumberg's dated 2011-2025 genealogy. Recurrence and feedback; world-models; self-models; senses, embodiment and agency; and assessment by indicators and credences are first stated together in 2023, after Micah's dated anchors, and again in 2024; the newest checked text states none of them as its own requirement. This private result is component-level and uncalibrated: it is not a persistent certified cluster, a derivation probability, or an access-and-intent finding.
